payload.title: Record a Papyrus relevance run for the Cyclotron marketing demo
payload.description:
Export a fixture of real Papyrus reviews changing the relevance cyclotron for the Cyclotron-web services page, in the editorial-run-v1 shape with source papyrus-live, using the engine export (decision-flywheel-de484ad0). Include only explanations whose review was marked shareable; redact others. Pick one review that led to a promoted version and record its before and after decisions. Ordering: last, after at least one promoted version in production.

Acceptance criteria:
- The fixture contains no non-shareable explanation, no editor email and no private corpus text beyond titles and public URLs.
- It names the cyclotron versions and the review that preceded the promotion.
- Ryan approves the fixture before it is copied into Cyclotron-web.,
